headline: UOB Organises China Business Tour for High-Net-Worth Heirs
summary: United Overseas Bank conducted an annual excursion bringing 26 participants to visit companies in Shanghai and Hangzhou. The initiative targets next-generation heirs of high-net-worth clients to deepen ties in wealth management.
why: Asian private wealth managers are competing intensely to retain intergenerational family fortunes amid an ongoing generational transfer of assets.

impacts.name: United Overseas Bank
impacts.why: Targeting next-generation family office heirs supports long-term client retention in private banking.
